parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs strong state anti-discrimination enforcement and functioning courts (88% support, 2026 civil-rights finding) with federal universal exposures: birth-sex passports/facilities, border discrepancy refusal with possible permanent fraud ineligibility, criminal bathroom trespass in some states, and documented custody abuse including hormone removal, forced labour and sexual abuse. No execution or highly likely imprisonment for presence, but state protections do not cancel federal entry, facilities or custody. Minor care bans add family exposure.

entry_documents.exposure: Binary birth-sex passport policy, X markers stopped for new issues, reported confiscations; border cable directs refusal on sex discrepancy and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility if wilful misrepresentation suspected.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; passport restrictions challenged by civil-liberties suit, though Supreme Court allowed them to take effect Nov 2025.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can trigger secondary screening, refusal, investigation for fraud and subsequent detention/custody placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections model from 2026 imposes hair cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports include forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts have blocked or enjoined some national orders, but no documented effective remedy for the custody practices described.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest or immigration detention can lead to birth-sex placement, care denial and abuse, with reporting of trans prisoners stopped from 2025.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; many states ban such use, 4 make it criminal in certain circumstances, with one handcuffed bathroom arrest and 24 hours in men's ward.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This state/province prohibits gender-identity discrimination in public accommodations and health care since 2019/2020, but dossier does not document it overriding national or bathroom bans.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State public-accommodation protection does not cancel national facilities, federal buildings or other states' trespass rules; map group membership for this state is not documented.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming medicine, surgery, puberty blockers, hormones and chest surgery for under-18s from 2025/2026, with provider discipline; national proposals would bar public insurance reimbursement for minors.
care_services.protection: State extended anti-discrimination coverage to health care in 2020; grandfather clause preserves treatment already underway as of 1 Jan 2026.
care_services.interaction: A travelling minor needing continuity may face denial or delay despite adult protections; custody hormone removal is a separate adult exposure.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at conception/birth, removes gender-identity materials, directs scrutiny of schools, and 2026 counterterrorism strategy targets 'radically pro-transgender' groups; diversity phrase also appears in rewards memo but not as criterion.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Bostock employment protection, national hate-crime statute, marriage recognition and several court injunctions limit some measures; challenges remain unresolved.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases police, school and border discretion, while courts provide partial but uncertain restraint.

minors_guardians.exposure: State care bans and girls' sports birth-certificate rule affect minors; national order directs criminal investigation of teachers facilitating social transition, including pronoun use.
minors_guardians.protection: State highest court ruled 3-1 to protect trans students on privacy/autonomy grounds; sports ban received temporary stay of uncertain outcome; disclosure bill died.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor faces care denial, school eligibility checks and forced disclosure risks not applying to adult alone.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2025 census raw count 72 incidents, second-highest without per-capita denominator, so rate cannot be inferred; documented bathroom arrest shows police enforcement exposure.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime enhancements for gender identity since 2019, panic defence abolished 2024, July 2026 court found striker violated civil-rights act, and 2022 poll found 88% support protections.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: State enforcement can punish attackers, but federal custody and facility enforcement operate independently of that protection.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit, executive-order challenges and proposed health rules unresolved; whether minor-care bans are enjoined and sports stay outcome are not established.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Functioning courts, legal-aid FAQ, state civil-rights enforcement and documented 2026 remedy show recourse can work in state/province sphere.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recourse is slow, stage-specific and does not document reversal of border refusal, facility exclusion or custody abuse in real time.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in routine identity checks, discretionary detention and weak real-time remedy, but higher because courts, state civil-rights enforcement and injunctions sometimes work, and imprisonment is not routine.
Lower than 0.55 because exposures extend beyond ward-by-marker delay to border refusal/permanent fraud risk, criminal bathroom trespass, and documented severe custody abuse.

Materially lower than 0.75: unlike brief secondary screening with counsel and compensation, this regime has universal birth-sex facilities/passports, possible lifetime ineligibility and unremedied custody harm.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one system: a congruent home passport may still trigger federal secondary screening, refusal or fraud inquiry; any detention moves into birth-sex custody with documented care removal and abuse; in-state facilities and services benefit from state anti-discrimination law and courts, but that does not preempt federal entry, federal facilities or custody. For minors, state care and sports rules add denial and disclosure exposure. Protections are real yet partial and litigated, while the most severe exposures are state-imposed and universal, placing the regime near the 0.35 anchor but above it due to functioning state recourse and absence of execution/highly likely imprisonment.
